paragraphs: I'm a final-year IT student at Jabalpur Engineering College and an LFX Mentee at the CNCF, working on Jaeger under Yuri Shkuro (Jaeger's creator) and Jonah Kowall. I built the Jaeger AI Self-Service Skills Framework: an MCP tool that lets any AI agent load expert trace-diagnosis playbooks on demand, and the plumbing that makes Jaeger trace its own agents.

I got into observability by troubleshooting a slow service while learning DevOps, and stayed because the question "why did this agent do that?" turns out to be the same question as "why is this request slow?". Outside code: swimming and writing poems.

experience.summary: Built the Jaeger AI Self-Service Skills Framework: an MCP tool that lets AI agents load expert trace-diagnosis playbooks on demand, an agent-agnostic gateway over ACP, and the tracing that lets Jaeger observe its own agents.

narrative.title: read_skill MCP tool
narrative.summary: Three-level progressive disclosure: catalog → sub-skill → references. An agent loads only the playbook it needs.
detail: Go. Handler depends only on fs.FS, secured with fs.ValidPath and os.OpenRoot.
Pure MCP, so zero sidecar changes: any MCP client gets skills for free.

narrative.title: Agent-agnostic gateway over ACP
narrative.summary: Fixed WebSocket message framing so any ACP agent connects, then added authenticated agents via configurable handshake headers.
detail: PR #9296 preserves message boundaries when reading ACP over WebSocket.
PR #9395 sends configopaque.MapList headers on the agent handshake.
Ran Gemini (Google ADK), Claude and Goose sidecars on the same gateway.

narrative.title: Self-tracing
narrative.summary: OpenTelemetry GenAI span attributes plus W3C traceparent across ACP. Gateway and sidecar spans join into one trace per chat turn.
detail: gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.conversation.id on agent spans.
gen_ai.tool.call.arguments / result on both sidecar and gateway tool-call spans.
The hero of this site is drawn from the same kind of trace.

narrative.title: Agent evaluation
narrative.summary: Agents skipped skills because they judged direct telemetry tools sufficient: a reasoning problem, not a discovery problem.
detail: 0/5 → 5/5 on both harnesses by putting disconfirming signals in the telemetry tool descriptions.
Two withdrawn conclusions: 36 runs misattributed after silent agent switching; a lazy-tool-loading false negative. Both are in the issue.

narrative.title: Trace fixtures and skill hardening
narrative.summary: Labeled trace fixtures and end-to-end coverage for the built-in skills. Operator skills served from ai.skills_dir.
detail: PR #9263: fixtures plus E2E tests so a skill regression fails CI.
PR #9169: operators add playbooks under custom/ without rebuilding Jaeger.
PR #9194: ai.enable_mcp replaced by an optional ai.mcp config block.

narrative.title: Agent chat UI
narrative.summary: Two jaeger-ui PRs: expandable tool-call blocks in the chat thread, Markdown rendering and panel resize.

FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, Docker Compose, pytest suites over ingestion, chunking and retrieval.
